identity.name: PowerShell Download and Execute via Command Line
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download a payload from a remote server and execute it directly in memory. Cortex detects this behavior via suspicious PowerShell command line arguments containing downl
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download a payload from a remote server and execute it directly in memory. Cortex detects this behavior via suspicious PowerShell command line arguments containing download commands.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started with suspicious command line

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PowerShell Download Command Line
biocs.description: PowerShell process with command line containing DownloadFile or Invoke-WebRequest
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'DownloadFile' or action_process_command_line contains 'Invoke-WebRequest'

abiocs.name: PowerShell Download and Execute
abiocs.description: PowerShell process with download and execution behavior in command line
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'DownloadFile' and action_process_command_line contains 'Start-Process'

xql_queries.name: PowerShell Download Activity
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'DownloadFile' or action_process_command_line contains 'Invoke-WebRequest'
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_command_line
